type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 — added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em CSS variable applied to all heading scales (h1, h2, h3). This reinforces Goyard brand identity of refined, airy spacing as a reusable token. Also replaced proprietary Goyard font with Cormorant Garamond (Google Fonts serif, luxury display quality), and replaced Newsreader with Lora (Google Fonts serif body). All woff2 references removed; fonts served via Google Fonts CDN @import.

motion-system.twistDescription: Easing curve swap (Intensity 4): All ease replaced with ease-in-out for a smoother, more deliberate feel; cubic-bezier(0.6,0,0.1,1) elevated to bold overshoot bounce cubic-bezier(0.68,-0.55,0.265,1.55); cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1) replaced with ease-in-out; ease-in-out replaced with cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1). Transforms Nike sharp athletic snap into elastic expressiveness.

grid-system.twistDescription: Container max-width tightened from 950px to 780px (18% reduction, editorial inward pull). The 12-column fixed-width layout column track widths were scaled proportionally from 67.5px to 55.5px per column to remain consistent with the narrowed container. This creates deeper lateral whitespace flanking every content section, amplifying the tension between Apple Siri's deliberate full-bleed device scatter (which bleeds outside the container) and the centered editorial reading column — a characteristic spatial strategy in Apple product pages where immersive visuals overflow a tight text core.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist D (Button padding shift, intensity 3): Increased horizontal padding on elements.button and elements.cta from 34px to 46px (+12px). Vertical padding (4px) unchanged. Produces wider, more prominent button feel while preserving the compact vertical rhythm.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Hover transition speed made more languid: all button hover state transition durations increased by +0.15s (from 0.4s to 0.55s). Only hover states are affected; default and active states retain the original 0.4s timing.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist F (Link hover style change, intensity 4): Changed underline thickness from 1px to 2px and extended animation duration from 0.3s to 0.4s for a more emphatic, visible hover underline effect.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Material shift (C) applied to the 'Design System Signals Across Sections' paragraph — added three sentences describing the tactile materiality the design evokes: the embossed-foil quality of the × grid mesh against the near-black field, the matte weight of the sandy platform evoking compressed earth or unglazed ceramic, and the physical hierarchy this creates between dull ground, glowing edge, and warm center.
